title: Peacock dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tail fan: outer ring -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='47' ry='40' fill='#1f6f4a'/>
  <!-- tail fan inner -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='38' ry='32' fill='#2f9a63'/>

  <g>
    <circle cx='18' cy='36' r='7' fill='#0f4a2e'/>

    <circle cx='30' cy='18' r='5' fill='#3fb0d0'/>

    <circle cx='50' cy='12' r='7' fill='#0f4a2e'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='12' r='5' fill='#3fb0d0'/>

    <circle cx='24' cy='56' r='2' fill='#f2c14e'/>
    <circle cx='76' cy='56' r='6' fill='#0f4a2e'/>
    <circle cx='76' cy='56' r='4' fill='#3fb0d0'/>
    <circle cx='76' cy='56' r='2' fill='#f2c14e'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='14' ry='18' fill='#2b6fd6'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='9' ry='12' fill='#4f8ff0'/>

  <ellipse cx='40' cy='70' rx='6' ry='11' fill='#1f4f9c'/>

  <g stroke='#3fb0d0' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'>

  <circle cx='55' cy='31' r='2' fill='#f2c14e'/>
